Easy Cold Process Soap Recipe for Beginners

Making your own soap is fun and rewarding. Always wear gloves and goggles when handling lye.

Ingredients

  • 500 g olive oil
  • 300 g coconut oil
  • 115 g lye (sodium hydroxide)
  • 260 ml distilled water

Instructions

  1. Slowly add the lye to the water and stir until dissolved. Let it cool.
  2. Melt the oils together and mix with the lye solution until trace.
  3. Pour into a soap mold and let it cure for 4–6 weeks.
